_readme: The kit listed on /geeks-corner. Each group is a heading with a list of items under it — one group per player, or per category, whatever suits. 'name' is the only required field on an item; 'what' is a short line saying what it is, and 'note' is for anything worth adding: why they use it, what it does to the sound, where it came from. Ask the band for the actual makes and models; do not guess at them.

items.name: Make and model goes here
items.note: Anything worth saying about it — why this one, what it does, how long he has had it.

items.name: KJM Studio
items.note: Two Lost Souls was recorded here, and produced by Andrew and Darren themselves.
